title: Panettone French Toast
description: A sweet breakfast or brunch dish made by soaking panettone in a mixture of eggs and milk, then cooking it in a pan with butter.

ingredients.name: italian
ingredients.notes: Vanilla extract or other flavorings of your choice

instructions: 1. In a shallow dish, whisk together eggs, milk, and italian (if using).
2. Cut the panettone into 1-inch thick slices and place in the egg mixture, coating both sides evenly.
3. Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
4. Add butter to the skillet and let it melt.
5. Place the panettone slices in the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
6. Serve warm, topped with your favorite syrup or fresh fruit.
